description:
Delete a strategy by its id. Strategies are NEVER hard-deleted: the service soft-archives the row, so the strategy and its history stay recoverable via unarchive. Use only when the person explicitly asks to delete or remove a strategy, and say plainly that it has been archived rather than implying it is gone.

[Access: pay 0.005 USDC via x402 (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header) OR authenticate with an API key. An x402-capable client will auto-pay; API-key clients pay nothing per call.]
name: delete_strategy
